t: The Fortress Trade 12" Roller Set is a comprehensive 4-piece painting kit, expertly assembled for efficient application of interior paints. This roller kit is ideal for professional decorators and keen DIYers undertaking significant wall and ceiling painting projects in residential or commercial properties. It includes a durable double-arm roller frame and 2 x 12" medium pile microfibre mix sleeves, ensuring excellent paint load and release with minimal lint loss. The robust paint tray features a deep ridged roll-off area, promoting even paint distribution for a consistent, professional finish. Replacement Fortress Trade inserts are readily available.
b: Deep Ridged Roll-Off Area for Even Paint Distribution
